S. I. U.
F. O. REQ
No. 520
Date 24/8/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

23rd August 1916.

Sir,
There is no truth in the newspaper reports regarding the troops at Woosung being dissatisfied regarding the manner in which they are paid.

A high official named Tsang Myoh Ling has arrived here from Peking to represent the Government at the celebration of General Yang's birthday.

One thousand two hundred persons have been enrolled in the society for assisting ex-rebels which has its headquarters at No. 155 Avenue Joffre. The promoters of the society, which is called Koh Ming Zeu Bu Wen 革命善後會 are all ex-rebel officers, but no prominent names appear amongst them. Prominent rebels such as Sun Yat Sen and Huang Hsin have no connection with the society, which seems to be organized by discontented ex-rebels who feel angry because they have not been given Government positions.
The society has nothing to do with the movement among the officials here for sending away ex-rebels.

There is no truth in the newspaper report which alleges that a bomb explosion occurred on North Chekiang Road on 21st instant. Enquiries show that a parcel of match boxes which were being carried on that road on the date in question by a young Chinese went on fire, and this incident gave rise to the story of a bomb explosion.

Taoyin Chow left for Nanking at 7.30 a.m. 23rd inst.

Your obedient servant,

（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

（签名）
Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
特别情报股 (S. I. U.)
外交部请求件
第 520 号
日期：1916年8月24日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916年8月23日。

先生：

报纸上关于吴淞驻军因薪饷发放方式而不满的报道，纯属子虚乌有。

一位名叫张妙龄（Tsang Myoh Ling，音译）的高级官员已从北京抵达此处，代表政府参加杨将军的寿辰庆典。

在霞飞路155号设有总部的“协助前革命党人协会”已招募了一千二百名会员。该协会名为“革命善后会”（Koh Ming Zeu Bu Wen），其发起者均为前革命党军官，但其中并无显赫人物。孙中山、黄兴等著名革命党人与该协会毫无关联；该协会似乎是由一些心怀不满的前革命党人组织的，他们因未获政府职位而愤懑不平。
该协会与本埠官员中要求遣送前革命党人的运动无关。

报纸报道声称本月21日浙江北路发生炸弹爆炸事件，此说并不属实。经查证，当日一名中国青年在该路上携带的一包火柴盒起火，这一意外事件引发了关于炸弹爆炸的谣言。

周道尹已于本月23日上午7时30分启程前往南京。

您忠顺的仆人，

（签名）
首席侦探督察长。

（签名）
警务处总监。
